policies.name: Patch Management Policy
policies.description: Policy governing the timely identification, testing and application of security patches.

policies.name: Vulnerability Management Policy
policies.description: Policy governing the identification, assessment and remediation of security vulnerabilities.

policies.name: Incident Response Policy
policies.description: Policy governing the detection, escalation, response and recovery from security incidents.

controls.name: Patch Management Process
controls.description: Process for identifying, assessing, testing and applying security patches.

controls.name: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Regular scanning of systems for known security vulnerabilities.

controls.name: Incident Response Process
controls.description: Defined process for detecting, escalating, investigating and resolving security incidents.

controls.name: Security Monitoring
controls.description: Monitoring control that checks web application availability and verifies database network isolation.

risks.name: Unpatched Vulnerabilities
risks.description: Risk of exploitation due to known vulnerabilities remaining unpatched.
risks.mitigation_plan: Implement formal patch management and vulnerability remediation tracking.

risks.name: Insufficient Network Segmentation
risks.description: Risk of lateral movement because systems share the same network segment.
risks.mitigation_plan: Implement network segmentation based on least privilege.

risks.name: Weak Database Access Controls
risks.description: Risk of unauthorized database access due to broad application account host permissions.
risks.mitigation_plan: Restrict database account access and review database privileges.

incidents.name: Simulated Web Server Exposure
incidents.description: Baseline security simulation identified a vulnerable Struts web application.
incidents.resolution: Struts vulnerability remediated and verified by post-control scan. Database access restriction and network segmentation were implemented and verified.

metrics.name: Patch Compliance
metrics.description: Percentage of systems with required security patches applied.

metrics.name: Critical Vulnerability Remediation Time
metrics.description: Average time to remediate critical vulnerabilities in days.

metrics.name: Security Incidents
metrics.description: Number of security incidents recorded during the reporting period.

audits.name: GRC102 Baseline Security Governance Assessment
audits.description: Baseline assessment of the simulated web application, database and network environment.
audits.findings: Unpatched Struts vulnerability, broad database account host permission and insufficient network segmentation were identified.
audits.recommendations: Implement patch management, strengthen database access controls and implement network segmentation.
